summary: Begin the owner-approved guardian/regional safety path with one internal provider-free policy evaluator and a concrete six-stage implementation plan. Preserve eligible 13+ ordinary actions and separate 18+ live AI. This foundation is not wired to current admission or provider dispatch.

Durable guardian verification, canonical subject/region readers, every provider boundary, UI/withdrawal, privacy and actual regional acceptance remain planned. No current role, account-wide age, provider, schema, live-AI policy or rollout changes.
